outline:
1.電腦網路概述
2.階層結構
3.路由與交換
4.流量與擁塞控制
5.媒體存取控制
6.區域網路協定與標準
７．網路互連
８．效能評估
schedule:
1	Class overview, Computer Networks and the Internet (Internet architecture, protocols, circuit- and packet-switching) Ch. 1.1-1.3, 1.8
2	Computer Networks and the Internet (access networks, physical media, delay and loss, layered architecture)	Ch. 1.4 - 1.7
3	Application Layer (Web, HTTP, FTP) Ch. 2.1 - 2.3
4	Application Layer (Email, DNS, p2p file sharing) Ch. 2.4 - 2.6
5	Socket Programming	Ch. 2.7-2.9
6	Transport Layer (intro, Multiplexing/demultiplexing, UDP)	Ch. 3.1 -3.3
7	Principles of reliable data transfer	Ch. 3.4
8	Connection-oriented transport: TCP	Ch. 3.5
9	TCP (congestion control)	Ch. 3.6 - 3.7
10	Midterm Exam
11	Network Layer (intro, routing principles, routing algorithms)	Ch. 4.1 – 4.2, 4.5
12	Network Layer (IP)	Ch. 4.4
13	Network Layer (hierarchical routing, RIP, OSPF, BGP) Ch. 4.4 - 4.5
14	Data Link Layer (intro, error detection/correction, multiple access protocols) Ch. 5.1 - 5.3
15	Data Link Layer (link-layer addressing, Ethernet, hubs and switches, Wireless Links)	Ch. 5.4 - 5.7
16	Wireless and Mobile Networks (intro, wireless links, 802.11 wireless LANs) Ch. 6.1 – 6.3
17	Networking Security	Ch. 7
18	Final Exam
